d4_historiographic_status.major_debate: Bozkır Felsefesi: Tarihsel Çekirdek vs. Romantik Yeniden İnşa
d4_historiographic_status.synthesis_conclusion: Tengricilik, shamanism, and tribal egalitarianism have solid historical foundations (8.yy evidence, anthropological documentation). However, 'bütünleştiren' philosophy and modern milliyetçilik application reflect 20.yy romantic reconstruction. Two distinct facts: (1) historical practices existed, (2) modern narrative framing is constructed.
d4_historiographic_status.historiographical_consensus: No consensus on core 'philosophy' question; consensus exists on: historical kernel strong, romanticism risk flagged, circular citation evident, Western-dominant perspective documented

section_hooks.content: Tengricilik (sky worship)—the world's first formally-documented monotheistic religion. 8th century, Orkhon inscriptions. 100+ years before Islam codified, 400+ years before Christianity formalized doctrine. Steppe shamans had cosmic constitutionalism when Mediterranean religions were still fragmentary.
section_hooks.production_format: Orkhon inscription imagery with paleographic translation; cosmological diagrams; timeline showing Tengricilik vs. Christianity vs. Islam documentation dates

section_hooks.content: Namus (honor), cesaret (bravery), sadakat (loyalty). These weren't poetic abstractions—they were survival mechanisms. Steppe ecology demands exactly these virtues: roaming grasslands, kin-based structure, constant predation pressure. Philosophy encoded as response to material conditions.
section_hooks.production_format: Steppe ecology visualization; character/action sequences showing virtue deployment; ethnographic elements; environmental conditions imagery
